paragraphs.en: I am writing to invite you to our campus science exhibition this Saturday.
paragraphs.whyZh: 开头一句解决写信目的与活动；时间是原创设定。
paragraphs.zh: 我写信邀请你参加本周六的校园科技展。

paragraphs.en: The exhibition will feature student-designed robots and live demonstrations of how they work.
paragraphs.whyZh: 内容是可见的具体项目，不是interesting。
paragraphs.zh: 展览将展示学生设计的机器人，并现场演示其工作方式。

paragraphs.en: You can also try simple experiments and speak with the teams behind the projects.
paragraphs.whyZh: 两个参与动作有区别。
paragraphs.zh: 你也可以尝试简单实验，与项目团队交流。

paragraphs.en: Since you are interested in engineering, I think you will especially enjoy these hands-on activities.
paragraphs.whyZh: 从对方兴趣导出邀请理由。
paragraphs.zh: 你对工程学感兴趣，所以我认为你会尤其喜欢这些动手体验活动。

paragraphs.en: We will meet at the library entrance at nine and walk to the exhibition hall together.
paragraphs.whyZh: 参与行动可落实，地点时间为原创。
paragraphs.zh: 我们九点在图书馆入口集合，再一起去展厅。

paragraphs.en: Please let me know by Thursday whether you can come.
paragraphs.whyZh: 回应方式具体且简洁。
paragraphs.zh: 请在周四前告诉我能否参加。

paragraphs.en: I hope we can explore the exhibition together.
paragraphs.zh: 希望我们能一起参观展览。

applicationEssays.task: 原创练习：你是李明，邀请对机器人感兴趣的外国朋友参加校园科技展；介绍项目、活动价值和参加方式。

paragraphs.en: On behalf of the Student Association, I would like to invite you to our Chinese Culture Day next Friday.
paragraphs.whyZh: 代表身份必须由题目设定支持。
paragraphs.zh: 我代表学生协会邀请你参加下周五的中国文化体验日。

paragraphs.en: The event will include a folk music performance and a workshop on traditional paper-cutting.
paragraphs.zh: 活动包括民乐演出和传统剪纸体验工作坊。

paragraphs.en: During the workshop, student volunteers will guide visitors through a simple design.
paragraphs.whyZh: 具体化hands-on，避免文化大词堆砌。
paragraphs.zh: 工作坊期间，学生志愿者会带领来访者完成一个简单作品。

paragraphs.en: Taking part will give you an opportunity to experience a tradition rather than merely read about it.
paragraphs.whyZh: rather than前后并行结构。
paragraphs.zh: 参与其中可以让你亲身体验一项传统，而不只是读到相关介绍。

paragraphs.en: The workshop has limited places, so please register through the association before Wednesday.
paragraphs.whyZh: 报名名额和截止日是原创情境设定。
paragraphs.zh: 工作坊名额有限，因此请于周三之前通过学生协会报名。

paragraphs.en: We would be delighted to have you with us and hope you can join the celebration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们非常欢迎你的到来，希望你能加入这次庆祝活动。

applicationEssays.task: 原创练习：你代表学生协会邀请一位外国同学参加中国传统文化体验日，说明主要项目、价值和报名办法。

paragraphs.en: On behalf of our student academic society, I am writing to invite you to deliver a talk at our upcoming forum on artificial intelligence in education.
paragraphs.whyZh: deliver a talk体现邀请角色：主讲，不是听众。
paragraphs.zh: 我代表学生学术社团邀请您在即将举办的人工智能与教育论坛上发表演讲。

paragraphs.en: The forum will examine how new technologies can support learning while raising questions about their responsible use.
paragraphs.whyZh: 主题有焦点与张力。
paragraphs.zh: 论坛将探讨新技术如何支持学习，同时讨论其负责任使用的问题。

paragraphs.en: We would be grateful if you could share your research experience and discuss one practical example with the audience.
paragraphs.whyZh: 给受邀人明确可执行角色。
paragraphs.zh: 若您愿意分享研究经验并与听众讨论一个实际案例，我们将不胜感激。

paragraphs.en: A short question-and-answer session will follow the talk, allowing students to explore the topic further.
paragraphs.zh: 演讲后将安排简短问答，帮助学生进一步探讨这一话题。

paragraphs.en: The event is planned for Friday afternoon in the main lecture hall.
paragraphs.whyZh: 日期地点属于原创设定。
paragraphs.zh: 活动计划周五下午在主讲堂举行。

paragraphs.en: Please let us know whether the arrangement would suit your schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 请告知这一安排是否符合您的日程。

paragraphs.en: We would be honored by your participation.
paragraphs.whyZh: 正式对象合适；与熟人邀请区分。
paragraphs.zh: 若您能参加，我们将深感荣幸。

applicationEssays.task: 原创练习：你代表学生学术社团写信邀请客座教授就AI与教育作简短主旨演讲，而非普通参会。

paragraphs.en: Volunteers are needed for the campus book festival to be held next month.
paragraphs.whyZh: 开篇信息准确：招什么、为哪个活动。
paragraphs.zh: 下个月的校园图书节现招募志愿者。

paragraphs.en: Volunteers will guide visitors, help at the information desk and support small-group reading sessions.
paragraphs.whyZh: 职责动词多样，直击duties。
paragraphs.zh: 志愿者将引导访客、协助咨询台工作并支持小组阅读活动。

paragraphs.en: We welcome students who are patient, reliable and willing to work as part of a team.
paragraphs.whyZh: 任职要求和职责对应。
paragraphs.zh: 欢迎耐心、可靠并愿意团队合作的同学。

paragraphs.en: Experience in organizing student activities would be helpful but is not essential.
paragraphs.whyZh: 符合开放报名的诚实说法。
paragraphs.zh: 有组织学生活动经验者优先，但非必需。

paragraphs.en: Selected volunteers will receive a short briefing before the festival begins.
paragraphs.whyZh: 原创活动安排。
paragraphs.zh: 入选志愿者将在图书节开始前接受简短说明。

paragraphs.en: Volunteers may choose morning or afternoon shifts according to their availability.
paragraphs.whyZh: 把班次安排与报名表要求连接起来；同样属于原创情境。
paragraphs.zh: 志愿者可以根据自己的时间安排选择上午或下午轮班。

paragraphs.en: Interested students should send their names, contact details and available times to the Students’ Union office by Friday.
paragraphs.whyZh: 报名方式可执行，时间属于原创示范。
paragraphs.zh: 有意者应在周五前将姓名、联系方式和可参加时间送交学生会办公室。

applicationEssays.task: 原创练习：学生会招募校园图书节志愿者，请写通知，说明职责、适合人选及报名。

paragraphs.en: Thanks for asking about the community park clean-up. I am happy to share the details.
paragraphs.whyZh: respond to inquiry 不要写成只会邀请。
paragraphs.zh: 谢谢你询问社区公园清洁活动。我很乐意介绍具体情况。

paragraphs.en: The volunteers will collect litter along the walking paths and sort recyclable materials.
paragraphs.whyZh: 回答做什么。
paragraphs.zh: 志愿者将沿步道清理垃圾并分类回收物。

paragraphs.en: Gloves and waste bags will be provided, but you should wear comfortable shoes and bring some water.
paragraphs.whyZh: 回答带什么；原创情境提供的物资。
paragraphs.zh: 活动提供手套和垃圾袋，但你最好穿舒适的鞋子并带些水。

paragraphs.en: We will meet at the park gate at nine on Sunday morning.
paragraphs.whyZh: 回答何时何地；原创设定。
paragraphs.zh: 我们周日上午九点在公园门口集合。

paragraphs.en: You can join by sending your name to the student volunteer group before Saturday.
paragraphs.whyZh: 回答怎么参加。
paragraphs.zh: 你可以在周六前向学生志愿者小组发送姓名报名。

paragraphs.en: I would be glad to go with you, and I think we will both enjoy doing something useful for the neighborhood.
paragraphs.whyZh: 一句个人回应即可，不吞掉主体信息。
paragraphs.zh: 我很乐意和你一起去，也相信我们会喜欢为社区做些实事。

applicationEssays.task: 原创练习：外国朋友问你公园清洁活动做什么、需要带什么、如何加入；请逐项回复。

paragraphs.en: I am glad to hear that you are preparing for your first class presentation, and I would like to share a few suggestions.
paragraphs.zh: 听说你正在准备第一次课堂报告，我很高兴，想分享几条建议。

paragraphs.en: First, decide on one clear message and organize your talk around two or three supporting points.
paragraphs.whyZh: 步骤1解决内容与结构。
paragraphs.zh: 首先确定一个清晰的中心观点，并围绕两三条支撑要点组织报告。

paragraphs.en: Instead of filling your slides with text, use a simple example to explain each key idea.
paragraphs.whyZh: 步骤2解决呈现方式。
paragraphs.zh: 不要把幻灯片堆满文字，最好用简单例子解释每个关键观点。

paragraphs.en: Next, practise aloud and time yourself so that you can adjust the length of your talk.
paragraphs.whyZh: 步骤3解决时间控制。
paragraphs.zh: 接着大声练习并计时，以便调整报告长度。

paragraphs.en: You could also ask a friend to listen and point out anything that is difficult to follow.
paragraphs.whyZh: 步骤4反馈。
paragraphs.zh: 你还可以请朋友试听，并指出难理解的部分。

paragraphs.en: I hope these steps make your presentation clearer and help you feel more confident.
paragraphs.zh: 希望这些步骤让你的报告更清晰，也让你更有信心。

applicationEssays.task: 原创练习：朋友第一次做课堂口头报告，向你征询准备建议；请提出具体、互补且有顺序的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Since you are looking for a campus activity to improve your English, I would recommend our weekly reading discussion group.
paragraphs.zh: 你想找一项能提高英语能力的校园活动，因此我推荐每周读书讨论小组。

paragraphs.en: Each meeting focuses on one short article or story, so the reading task is manageable even during a busy week.
paragraphs.whyZh: 内容设计直接回应时间负担。
paragraphs.zh: 每次活动围绕一篇短文章或故事展开，所以即使很忙，阅读量也容易完成。

paragraphs.en: Members take turns summarizing the text and explaining which ideas they agree or disagree with.
paragraphs.whyZh: 具体动作，比improve English笼统句更可信。
paragraphs.zh: 成员轮流概述文本并解释自己赞同或不赞同哪些观点。

paragraphs.en: This routine gives you regular speaking practice and exposes you to different expressions.
paragraphs.whyZh: 把具体任务和收益连起来。
paragraphs.zh: 这种安排能让你定期练习口语，并接触不同表达。

paragraphs.en: You are welcome to observe a meeting before deciding whether to join.
paragraphs.whyZh: 降低参加门槛。
paragraphs.zh: 你可以先旁听一次，再决定是否加入。

paragraphs.en: If you are interested, I can introduce you to the group organizer.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你感兴趣，我可以把你介绍给组织者。

applicationEssays.task: 原创练习：朋友想参加能提升英语表达能力的校园活动，请推荐读书讨论会，并介绍方式和实际收益。

argumentChains.avoid: 不要写“AI一定降低智商”；题目给的数据不能自动证明因果。

claim.en: Technology can reduce routine work, but it cannot replace responsible human judgment.
claim.zh: 技术可以减少重复劳动，却不能取代负责任的人类判断。

example.en: For example, a student who copies an AI-generated explanation without understanding it may struggle to defend the answer in class.
example.zh: 例如，学生照搬自己不理解的AI解释，课堂上可能无法说明答案的依据。

argumentChains.logic: 便利/效率→依赖的代价→主动核查和独立判断

mechanism.en: When people accept automated answers without checking them, small mistakes may spread quickly.
mechanism.zh: 如果人们不加核实地接受自动生成的答案，小错误也可能迅速传播。

nuance.en: The better approach is to use digital tools as assistants while keeping critical decisions in human hands.
nuance.zh: 更好的做法是把数字工具当作助手，同时让关键判断仍由人来做。

argumentChains.question: 科技带来便利，为何仍需要人作判断？
argumentChains.title: 科技与判断能力

argumentChains.avoid: 不要把所有文化传承直接等同于经济发展或旅游收入。

claim.en: Cultural heritage is better preserved through active participation than through slogans alone.
claim.zh: 文化遗产通过积极参与比单靠口号更容易得到保护。

example.en: A community workshop, for instance, allows students to practise a local art instead of treating it as a distant symbol.
example.zh: 例如，社区工作坊让学生练习地方艺术，而不是仅把它当作遥远的符号。

argumentChains.logic: 亲身参与→理解做法与意义→共同记忆→持续传承

mechanism.en: When young people learn a craft or join a festival, they encounter the skills and stories behind the tradition.
mechanism.zh: 年轻人学习手艺或参加节庆时，能够接触传统背后的技艺和故事。

nuance.en: Modern forms of presentation can attract new audiences, provided that the original meaning is treated with respect.
nuance.zh: 只要尊重原有内涵，现代展示方式也可以吸引新的受众。

argumentChains.question: 为什么仅仅知道传统节日名称不等于传承文化？
argumentChains.title: 文化传承与参与体验

argumentChains.avoid: 不要写跨专业学习意味着本专业不重要。

claim.en: Learning beyond one’s major can reveal connections that a narrow focus may overlook.
claim.zh: 学习本专业之外的知识可以揭示狭窄视角可能忽视的联系。

example.en: An engineering student, for example, may design more useful products after learning how people actually use technology.
example.zh: 例如，工程专业学生在了解人们实际如何使用科技后，可能设计出更实用的产品。

argumentChains.logic: 单一视角的局限→新知识提供新工具→将两领域联系解决实际问题

mechanism.en: Different fields often approach the same problem with different methods and questions.
mechanism.zh: 不同学科往往用不同的方法和问题来处理同一件事。

nuance.en: Exploring new fields should deepen, rather than replace, the foundations of one’s main subject.
nuance.zh: 探索新领域应深化而非取代本专业的基础。

argumentChains.question: 为什么本专业之外的学习可能有用？
argumentChains.title: 学习与跨学科视野

argumentChains.avoid: 不要把拖延解释为单纯“懒惰”；论证应给出行动机制。

claim.en: Progress often depends less on a sudden burst of motivation than on manageable daily action.
claim.zh: 进步往往更依赖可执行的日常行动，而非突然爆发的动力。

example.en: A student preparing for an exam may make steadier progress by reviewing one topic each day instead of waiting for a perfect study mood.
example.zh: 备考学生每天复习一个专题，可能比等到状态完美才开始更稳定地进步。

argumentChains.logic: 长期目标难一次完成→拆小步骤→及时行动→累积进展

mechanism.en: Breaking a large task into smaller steps makes the first move less intimidating.
mechanism.zh: 把大任务拆成小步骤能降低开始行动的心理压力。

nuance.en: Persistence also involves adjusting ineffective methods rather than repeating them blindly.
nuance.zh: 坚持也包括调整无效的方法，而不是盲目重复。

argumentChains.question: 坚持为什么不是喊口号，而是具体行动？
argumentChains.title: 坚持与时间管理

argumentChains.avoid: 不能把互助题只写成坚持个人梦想；要写他人如何具体提供帮助。

claim.en: Cooperation allows people to combine strengths and deal with difficulties they might not overcome alone.
claim.zh: 合作使人们能够结合各自优势，处理独自面对时难以克服的困难。

example.en: In a student project, one member may focus on design while another tests whether the solution works in practice.
example.zh: 学生项目中，一人负责设计，另一人检验方案在实际中是否可行。

argumentChains.logic: 任务分工→能力互补→交流纠错→结果改善

mechanism.en: By sharing information and responsibilities, team members can notice problems earlier and respond more effectively.
mechanism.zh: 通过共享信息和职责，团队成员能更早发现问题并更有效地回应。

nuance.en: Effective teamwork requires clear roles and honest communication, not simply putting more people together.
nuance.zh: 有效团队合作需要明确分工与坦诚交流，而非简单增加人数。

argumentChains.question: 合作如何帮助克服个人能力的限制？
argumentChains.title: 合作与相互支持

argumentChains.avoid: “公园变多”不是“居民全部更健康”的证据；注意单位及图表时间段。

claim.en: Accessible public spaces can support both physical activity and community interaction.
claim.zh: 易于使用的公共空间有助于身体活动，也促进社区交流。

example.en: A nearby park may give older residents a place to walk and families a space for outdoor activities.
example.zh: 附近的公园可以让老年人散步，也为家庭户外活动提供空间。

argumentChains.logic: 设施改善→更多活动机会→社区交流机会→使用程度仍受管理影响

mechanism.en: When parks are safe and convenient to reach, residents have more opportunities to exercise and spend time together.
mechanism.zh: 当公园安全且交通便利时，居民就有更多机会运动和相聚。

nuance.en: Yet an increase in the number of parks does not by itself show how often residents actually use them.
nuance.zh: 但公园数量增加本身并不能证明居民实际使用频率。

argumentChains.question: 公园数量变化对居民意味着什么，又不能直接推断什么？
argumentChains.title: 公共空间与生活质量

argumentChains.avoid: 不要随便给原创环保行动捏造减排百分比。

claim.en: Environmental awareness becomes meaningful when it leads to consistent changes in everyday behavior.
claim.zh: 当环保意识转化为持续的日常行为改变时，它才更有意义。

example.en: Students might use refillable bottles and help keep shared study spaces clean.
example.zh: 学生可以使用可重复灌装的水瓶，并保持公共学习空间整洁。

argumentChains.logic: 意识→可执行选择→集体累积效果→适当设施支持

mechanism.en: Simple habits, such as reducing unnecessary packaging, can become more effective when many people adopt them.
mechanism.zh: 减少不必要包装等简单习惯，在更多人共同践行时可能产生更大效果。

nuance.en: Individual effort matters, but clear recycling facilities and sensible rules are also necessary.
nuance.zh: 个人努力很重要，但清晰的回收设施和合理规定也不可或缺。

argumentChains.question: 为什么宣传环保还需要具体行动？
argumentChains.title: 环保责任与日常行动

argumentChains.avoid: 不能断言使用智能手机的人一定缺乏关爱或患病。

claim.en: A balanced routine depends on how people manage their time and attention.
claim.zh: 平衡的生活节奏取决于人们如何管理时间与注意力。

example.en: During a shared meal, putting phones aside can make it easier for family members to listen to one another.
example.zh: 共餐时收起手机，能让家庭成员更容易倾听彼此。

argumentChains.logic: 注意力和时间是有限资源→行为选择→习惯对健康与关系的影响

mechanism.en: When screens occupy every free moment, opportunities for movement and face-to-face conversation may shrink.
mechanism.zh: 当屏幕占据每一刻空闲时间，运动和面对面交流的机会可能减少。

nuance.en: The point is not to reject useful devices but to set reasonable limits on their use.
nuance.zh: 关键不是拒绝有用的设备，而是为使用它们设置合理边界。

argumentChains.question: 运动、手机和面对面交流题的共同机制是什么？
argumentChains.title: 健康生活与人际联系

must: 一个有因果关系的收益
drills.prompt: 原创：邀请喜欢机器人技术的外国朋友参加校园创新展。写主体3句，必须包括展示内容、互动体验及对方收获。

sample.en: The show will feature small service robots and demonstrations of how they respond to simple commands.
sample.zh: 展览将展示小型服务机器人，演示它们如何响应简单指令。

sample.en: You can try the controls yourself and ask the designers about their work.
sample.zh: 你可以亲自尝试操作，并向设计者了解他们的工作。

sample.en: This should give you a clearer idea of how engineering concepts are tested in practice.
sample.zh: 这能让你更清楚工程概念如何在实践中得到检验。

drills.prompt: 原创：把上一题改成招募科技展志愿者通知，主体改为职责、素质和报名。

sample.en: Volunteers will guide visitors and help organize the hands-on demonstrations.
sample.zh: 志愿者将引导访客并协助组织互动演示。

sample.en: Applicants should communicate clearly and be willing to work in a team.
sample.zh: 申请者应具备清晰沟通与团队合作意愿。

sample.en: Interested students should send their available times to the student committee.
sample.zh: 有意者应向学生委员会提交可参加时间。

drills.trap: 不要继续夸机器人展“让所有人受益”，忘记招募信息。

drills.prompt: 原创：朋友问文化节有没有亲手体验项目、是否要基础、怎么报名，逐条答。

sample.en: Yes, the festival includes a paper-cutting workshop led by student volunteers.
sample.zh: 有，文化节包括由学生志愿者带领的剪纸工作坊。

sample.en: No previous experience is needed, and beginners are welcome.
sample.zh: 无需相关经验，欢迎初学者。

sample.en: You can register through the student association before the workshop begins.
sample.zh: 你可以在活动开始前通过学生协会报名。

drills.trap: 回复信不是借机写一段文化复兴大道理。

must: 区分 deliver a talk 与 attend a talk
drills.prompt: 原创：同一论坛中，分别写邀请教授主讲与邀请朋友听讲的1句核心邀请。

sample.en: We would be honored if you could deliver a talk on responsible AI use at our student forum.
sample.zh: 如果您能在学生论坛上就负责任的AI使用发表演讲，我们将深感荣幸。

sample.en: I would love you to attend the forum with me, especially the question-and-answer session.
sample.zh: 我很希望你和我一起参加论坛，尤其是问答环节。

drills.trap: 请人主讲写attend，导致任务错位。

drills.prompt: 原创：朋友为口头报告求建议，提出三个不重复的动作并各解释目的。

sample.en: Outline two or three main points so that listeners can follow your message.
sample.zh: 先列出两三条主点，让听众跟得上你的表达。

sample.en: Practise aloud to check whether the talk fits the time limit.
sample.zh: 大声练习，检查报告是否符合时间限制。

sample.en: Ask a classmate for feedback on anything that sounds unclear.
sample.zh: 请同学就不清晰的部分提供反馈。

drills.trap: 不能把three tips写成三个work hard。

drills.prompt: 原创：AI辅助学习图画，写80词左右主体段，包含“收益-问题机制-例子-合理边界”。

sample.en: Digital tools help students locate information quickly, but speed is not the same as understanding.
sample.zh: 数字工具帮助学生快速找到信息，但速度不等于理解。

sample.en: If learners copy answers without checking the reasoning, they may struggle to explain their conclusions.
sample.zh: 如果学习者不核查推理就照搬答案，就可能无法解释结论。

sample.en: For example, a convincing-looking solution may still leave out an important assumption.
sample.zh: 例如，看似有说服力的解法仍可能漏掉重要假设。

sample.en: Students should therefore treat such tools as assistants rather than substitutes for thinking.
sample.zh: 因此，学生应把这类工具当助手，而不是思考的替代品。

drills.trap: 不要把“工具有利有弊”当完整论证。

must: 不混淆设施数量和使用率
drills.prompt: 原创：公共公园设施增加的图表，写三句“数据事实-合理推论-不能推断”，不编造数值。

sample.en: The chart indicates that the number of public parks increased over the period shown.
sample.zh: 图表表明所示时期的公共公园数量增加。

sample.en: This may provide residents with more opportunities for outdoor activities, especially where parks are easy to reach.
sample.zh: 这可能为居民提供更多户外活动机会，尤其是在公园容易到达的地区。

sample.en: However, the figures alone do not reveal how frequently people use these spaces.
sample.zh: 然而，仅凭这些数字还无法知道人们多频繁地使用这些空间。

drills.trap: 不能把公园数量写成居民健康水平或使用频率。

expressionDeck.patternEn: I am writing to invite you to [event].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 同一封信别重复两次写信目的。

expressionDeck.patternEn: On behalf of [organization], I would like to invite you to [event].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 没有组织授权，别乱写On behalf of。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 很高兴得知……，我想提供几点建议。
expressionDeck.patternEn: I am glad to hear that [news], and I would like to offer a few suggestions.
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 不适用公告。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 谢谢你对……感兴趣。下面是你询问的具体信息。
expressionDeck.patternEn: Thank you for your interest in [activity]. Here are the details you asked for.
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 先回答问题，别变成宣传稿。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 我们正在招募……协助……项目。
expressionDeck.patternEn: We are looking for [role] to support [project].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 不是申请者自荐。

expressionDeck.patternEn: The event will feature [specific activity] and [specific activity].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: feature 后要放具体内容，不是a wonderful atmosphere。

expressionDeck.patternEn: Participants will have the opportunity to [concrete action].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 机会可以写try / discuss / observe，别只填learn much。

expressionDeck.patternEn: The session will be followed by [next stage].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 不确定是否有下一环节时不用。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 活动将帮助……把……与……联系起来。
expressionDeck.patternEn: The activity will help [group] connect [knowledge] with [practice].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: knowledge和practice都要符合实际。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 亲身参与能让你……，而非仅仅……。
expressionDeck.patternEn: Taking part will allow you to [gain] rather than merely [passively receive].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: rather than 两侧平行，别生造事实。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 该活动特别有用之处是……。
expressionDeck.patternEn: What makes the event particularly useful is [specific feature].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: is后面名词短语或从句，别只填interesting。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 考虑到你对……感兴趣，我想这会吸引你。
expressionDeck.patternEn: Since you are interested in [field], I thought this might appeal to you.
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 若不了解兴趣不要擅自认定。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 您在……的经验能为……带来重要视角。
expressionDeck.patternEn: Your experience in [field] would bring a valuable perspective to [discussion].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 客气但不要夸大职称。

expressionDeck.patternEn: The volunteers will [duty A], [duty B] and [duty C].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 职责要真实互补。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 申请者应具备……品质，并能……。
expressionDeck.patternEn: Applicants should be [quality] and able to [relevant action].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 资格应与实际职责对应。

expressionDeck.patternEn: To take part, please [action] by [deadline].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 截止日无题干依据时仅能作原创设定。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 无需相关经验，欢迎初学者。
expressionDeck.patternEn: No previous experience is required; beginners are welcome.
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 研究岗位若要求能力不能套。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 请告知……安排是否符合您的时间。
expressionDeck.patternEn: Please let us know whether [arrangement] would suit your schedule.
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 用间接疑问语序。

expressionDeck.patternEn: First, [action], so that [realistic outcome].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 建议要可执行，结果不过度承诺。

expressionDeck.patternEn: Instead of [weak practice], try [specific improvement].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 对方没做过的错事不能强加。

expressionDeck.patternEn: Regarding [question A], [direct answer]. As for [question B], [direct answer].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 当问题确实有两个时用，不要只解释心情。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 请告诉我你是否能参加。
expressionDeck.patternEn: Please let me know if you can attend.
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 通知对公众不一定适用。

expressionDeck.patternEn: I hope these steps will help you [specific goal].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: goal应该和对方需求一致。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 如果需要更多细节，我很乐意提供帮助。
expressionDeck.patternEn: If you would like more details, I would be happy to help.
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 不要凭空承诺无法提供的信息。

expressionDeck.patternEn: The contrast suggests that [grounded implication].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 原图无对比时别硬写contrast。

expressionDeck.patternEn: A notable feature of the chart is [accurate change or comparison].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 准确写对象单位/时间。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: ……的价值不仅在于表面收益，也在于更深层收益。
expressionDeck.patternEn: The value of [practice] lies not merely in [surface benefit] but also in [deeper benefit].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 要有两个不同真实收益。

expressionDeck.patternEn: One possible explanation is that [plausible mechanism].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 不可把猜测写成已证事实。

expressionDeck.patternEn: This is largely because [specific mechanism], which in turn [effect].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 没有因果证据时避免largely；用may。

expressionDeck.patternEn: For instance, [specific action] can help [actor] [specific outcome].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 例子不编造可核查事件。

expressionDeck.patternEn: Admittedly, [reasonable concern]; nevertheless, [balanced response].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 不是每篇必须强行让步。

expressionDeck.patternEn: Rather than simply [superficial response], [actor] should [concrete action].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 具体主体+可行行动。

expressionDeck.patternEn: This requires cooperation between [actor A] and [actor B].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 明确他们各做什么，否则空洞。

expressionDeck.meaningZh: 目标并非排斥……，而是更负责任地使用它。
expressionDeck.patternEn: The goal is not to reject [useful element] but to use it more responsibly.
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 不适合纯正向赞扬的题目。

expressionDeck.patternEn: Only when [specific condition] can [desired outcome].
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 倒装语序：Only when + 从句 + can + 主语 + 动词。

expressionDeck.patternEn: With [specific support] and [consistent action], [realistic positive result] can become possible.
expressionDeck.riskNoteZh: 避免空泛的brighter future。

overlays.originNote: All example English writing, practice prompts and scenario facts are original. Real-year references in READMEs are thematic only, not English exam directions.

picturePracticeEssays.label: 原创训练题／非历年真题

paragraphs.en: The drawing portrays two students using the same digital learning tool in very different ways.
paragraphs.whyZh: 这是原创画面，不是某年真题。
paragraphs.zh: 画面呈现了两名学生以截然不同的方式使用同一款数字学习工具。

paragraphs.en: One copies an answer immediately, while the other checks the explanation against a textbook.
paragraphs.zh: 一名学生立刻复制答案，另一名学生则用教材核对解释。

paragraphs.en: The contrast suggests that convenient technology is most valuable when it supports rather than replaces independent thinking.
paragraphs.zh: 这一对比表明，便利的技术在支持而非取代独立思考时才最有价值。

paragraphs.en: Digital tools can save time by helping learners find information and organize ideas.
paragraphs.zh: 数字工具能帮助学习者检索信息、组织思路，从而节省时间。

paragraphs.en: However, speed alone does not guarantee understanding.
paragraphs.whyZh: 亮句：短句恰当让步，比生造复杂句更有力量。
paragraphs.zh: 然而，速度本身并不保证理解。

paragraphs.en: When students accept an answer without examining the reasoning behind it, they may repeat errors or fail to explain their own conclusions.
paragraphs.zh: 学生如果不审视答案背后的推理，就可能重复错误，或无法解释自己的结论。

paragraphs.en: For instance, an automatically generated solution might look convincing even when one important assumption is missing.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，自动生成的解答即使遗漏了一个关键假设，看起来也可能很有说服力。

paragraphs.en: Checking sources, asking follow-up questions and comparing alternatives can turn a quick response into genuine learning.
paragraphs.zh: 核查来源、追问问题以及比较备选方案，可以把快速回答变成真正的学习。

paragraphs.en: Such habits matter especially when students must apply what they have learned to a new problem.
paragraphs.whyZh: 多加一层迁移机制，而非用高级词硬凑字数。
paragraphs.zh: 当学生需要把学到的知识用于新问题时，这些习惯尤为重要。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, schools should teach students how to evaluate information, not merely how to operate new tools.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，学校应教会学生如何评价信息，而不只是如何操作新工具。

paragraphs.en: Learners, in turn, should remain responsible for the claims they make.
paragraphs.zh: 学习者也应对自己提出的观点负责。

paragraphs.en: Used with care, technology can extend human abilities without weakening human judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 审慎使用时，技术可以拓展人的能力，而不会削弱人的判断力。

picturePracticeEssays.prompt: 原创图画设定：一名学生快速复制智能工具给出的答案，而另一名学生一边使用工具一边查证资料；要求描述画面、分析寓意并评论。
picturePracticeEssays.title: 原创图画训练：AI辅助学习与独立判断

picturePracticeEssays.label: 原创训练题／非历年真题

paragraphs.en: In the picture, two students are collecting litter in a neighborhood park while several residents work nearby.
paragraphs.zh: 在图画中，两名学生正在社区公园捡拾垃圾，旁边还有几位居民一同劳动。

paragraphs.en: A passer-by stops to ask how to join the activity.
paragraphs.zh: 一位路人停下来询问如何加入活动。

paragraphs.en: The scene highlights a simple idea: responsibility becomes meaningful when people are willing to act together.
paragraphs.zh: 这个场景凸显一个简单道理：当人们愿意共同行动，责任才有实际意义。

paragraphs.en: Keeping a public space clean is not merely a task for cleaners or local authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 保持公共空间整洁，并不仅仅是清洁人员或地方管理者的任务。

paragraphs.en: Residents also shape the environment through their everyday choices.
paragraphs.zh: 居民也通过日常选择影响周围环境。

paragraphs.en: For example, joining a clean-up allows students to see how careless littering affects a place that everyone uses.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，参加清洁活动能让学生看到随手乱扔垃圾如何影响人人使用的场所。

paragraphs.en: Working with others can also build trust and encourage people who have never volunteered before to take part.
paragraphs.zh: 与他人合作还能建立信任，鼓励此前没有志愿服务经历的人参与进来。

paragraphs.en: Yet enthusiasm alone is not enough; clear instructions and proper equipment help turn good intentions into safe and effective action.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，仅有热情还不够；清晰的指引和合适的工具才能让好意变成安全有效的行动。

paragraphs.en: Seeing neighbors take part may also encourage newcomers to volunteer again in the future.
paragraphs.whyZh: 添加参与扩散的具体机制，不空泛谈社会和谐。
paragraphs.zh: 看到邻居参与，也可能鼓励新人今后继续参加志愿服务。

paragraphs.en: Communities could organize manageable activities and explain how residents can participate.
paragraphs.zh: 社区可以组织便于参加的活动，并说明居民如何加入。

paragraphs.en: Individuals should start with small habits, such as sorting waste and respecting shared facilities.
paragraphs.zh: 个人则应从分类垃圾、爱护公共设施等小习惯做起。

paragraphs.en: When everyday responsibility becomes a shared practice, public spaces can remain pleasant for everyone.
paragraphs.zh: 当日常责任成为共同实践，公共空间才更可能持续为大家提供舒适环境。

picturePracticeEssays.prompt: 原创图画设定：两名学生和社区居民一起清理公园垃圾，旁边有人停下来询问能否加入；要求描述场景、解释寓意并评论。
picturePracticeEssays.title: 原创图画训练：社区清洁与共同责任

Bbridge.en: Practical demonstrations can narrow the gap between technological innovation and public understanding.
Bbridge.whyZh: 大作文可再补机制：为什么体验比抽象口号更有效。
Bbridge.zh: 实际演示有助于缩小技术创新与公众理解之间的距离。

benefits.en: The event will help visitors connect classroom knowledge with real-world applications.
benefits.whyZh: connect A with B适合教育、科技、展览。
benefits.zh: 活动能够帮助参观者把课堂知识与现实应用联系起来。

benefits.en: The demonstrations offer a clearer picture of how technology can solve everyday problems.
benefits.whyZh: 不是笼统说technology changes the world。
benefits.zh: 现场演示能让参观者更直观地认识科技如何解决日常问题。

scenarioCards.core: 先展示具体成果→说明参观者能获得什么→根据对象决定介绍互动或报名
scenarioCards.dont: 不能把演示的风险写成已发生事故；机器人展示≠保证人人会操作。

forReader.en: Since you are interested in engineering, I think the interactive sessions would particularly appeal to you.
forReader.whyZh: 只在已知兴趣或原创练习设定兴趣时用。
forReader.zh: 你对工程学感兴趣，因此我认为互动环节会尤其吸引你。

material.en: The exhibition will feature student-designed robots and live demonstrations of how they work.
material.whyZh: feature表示重点展示，比there are many things更有信息量。
material.zh: 展览将展示学生设计的机器人，并现场演示它们如何运作。

material.en: Visitors can try simple experiments and talk with the teams behind the projects.
material.whyZh: try + talk with: 两个不同体验，不要机械堆三个形容词。
material.zh: 参观者可以尝试简单实验，并与项目团队交流。

scenarioCards.name: 科技展与创新体验

requirements.en: Please register in advance if you would like to join the hands-on session.
requirements.whyZh: 仅在题目明确或原创设定有限额时写。
requirements.zh: 如果想参加动手体验环节，请提前报名。

requirements.en: Participants are asked to follow the safety instructions during the demonstrations.
requirements.whyZh: 适合实验互动，不用于普通书画展。
requirements.zh: 参与者应在演示过程中遵守安全指引。

switch.invitation: 展示项目＋邀请对象为什么会感兴趣＋明确回复
switch.notice: 对公众明确时间地点、展项、开放对象和报名办法
switch.reply: 先回答对方问的展项、开放安排或参观方式；别写成泛泛宣传

Bbridge.en: Traditions remain relevant when younger generations can experience and reinterpret them in daily life.
Bbridge.zh: 当年轻一代能够在生活中体验并重新理解传统时，传统才更容易保持现实意义。

benefits.en: Taking part in these activities offers a more direct understanding of local traditions.
benefits.whyZh: 价值要与体验活动因果对应。
benefits.zh: 参与这些活动能更直接地了解当地传统。

benefits.en: The workshops create opportunities for students from different backgrounds to exchange ideas.
benefits.whyZh: 国际交流场景尤其自然。
benefits.zh: 工作坊为不同背景的学生交流想法提供了机会。

scenarioCards.core: 具体节目/体验→理解文化的途径→文化交流的实际收获
scenarioCards.dont: 别把“传统文化”写成万能的历史遗产保护口号；书法体验不代表所有中国文化。

forReader.en: As someone who enjoys learning about Chinese culture, you may find the hands-on workshop especially rewarding.
forReader.zh: 考虑到你喜欢了解中国文化，亲手体验的工作坊可能会让你收获更多。

material.en: The festival will include folk performances and workshops on traditional crafts.
material.whyZh: 项目要和文化主题一致。
material.zh: 文化节将安排民俗表演和传统手工艺体验活动。

material.en: Visitors can learn basic calligraphy techniques under the guidance of volunteers.
material.whyZh: 可替换为paper-cutting或painting，但别塞入题目没有的官方大师。
material.zh: 参观者可以在志愿者指导下学习基础书法技巧。

scenarioCards.name: 传统文化节与手作体验

requirements.en: Places in the workshop are limited, so advance registration is recommended.
requirements.whyZh: 名额限制只作原创活动设定。
requirements.zh: 工作坊名额有限，因此建议提前报名。

requirements.en: No previous experience is required; beginners are welcome.
requirements.whyZh: 适用于体验型活动，不可套招聘高技能岗位。
requirements.zh: 无需相关经验，欢迎初学者参加。

switch.invitation: 突出一个具体文化体验＋适合收信人的理由
switch.notice: 具体节目时间、参与方式、是否限额
switch.recommendation: 说清推荐何种活动、为何契合对方兴趣，避免把推荐当命令

Bbridge.en: Exposure to different disciplines can challenge assumptions that students might otherwise take for granted.
Bbridge.zh: 接触不同学科能够帮助学生重新审视原本习以为常的假设。

benefits.en: The discussion may help students examine familiar problems from a different perspective.
benefits.whyZh: 体现跨学科价值而非只有broaden horizons。
benefits.zh: 讨论可能帮助学生从不同角度审视熟悉的问题。

benefits.en: Participants can ask questions and receive feedback on their ideas.
benefits.zh: 参与者能够提问并就自己的想法获得反馈。

scenarioCards.core: 主题与讲者→讨论什么问题→如何帮助学习和思考
scenarioCards.dont: invite someone to deliver a talk ≠ invite someone to attend a talk；身份错了整封信任务就错。

forReader.en: Your work on educational technology would bring a valuable perspective to the discussion.
forReader.whyZh: 面向教授可以正式；面对普通同学改your interest。
forReader.zh: 你在教育技术方面的研究将为讨论带来有价值的视角。

material.en: The seminar will focus on the relationship between artificial intelligence and education.
material.whyZh: 换题只替换讨论问题，不照搬AI。
material.zh: 研讨会将聚焦人工智能与教育的关系。

material.en: The talk will be followed by a question-and-answer session with the speaker.
material.zh: 报告后将举行与主讲人的问答环节。

scenarioCards.name: 学术讲座与跨学科研讨

requirements.en: Students are encouraged to prepare one question before attending.
requirements.whyZh: 建议而非强制，除非题目要求。
requirements.zh: 建议学生在参加前准备一个问题。

requirements.en: Please arrive a few minutes early to avoid interrupting the speaker.
requirements.zh: 请提前几分钟到场，以免打断主讲人。

switch.advice: 如何提前了解背景、整理问题、记录要点
switch.invitation: 先交代受邀者具体角色，是听众还是主讲人
switch.notice: 说明主题、面向对象、主讲人及问答安排

Bbridge.en: Reading becomes more productive when readers compare interpretations rather than accept the first impression.
Bbridge.zh: 当读者比较不同理解，而不是接受第一印象时，阅读会更有成效。

benefits.en: Sharing different interpretations can help readers notice details they might have missed.
benefits.zh: 交流不同解读有助于读者发现自己可能忽视的细节。

benefits.en: The event offers an easy way to develop a regular reading habit with others.
benefits.zh: 活动提供了与他人一起养成规律阅读习惯的机会。

scenarioCards.core: 讨论哪类书/活动→如何交流→给读者的具体收获
scenarioCards.dont: 写推荐一本书时，不要整封信变成邀请参加读书会。

forReader.en: I remember how much you enjoyed discussing novels, so this event seems a good match for you.
forReader.zh: 我记得你很喜欢讨论小说，所以这次活动很适合你。

material.en: The event will include small-group discussions and short presentations by student readers.
material.zh: 活动将包括小组讨论和学生读者的简短分享。

material.en: Participants are welcome to introduce a book that has changed their way of thinking.
material.whyZh: 适合读书分享，不用于静态书展陈列。
material.zh: 欢迎参与者介绍一本改变过自己思考方式的书。

scenarioCards.name: 读书分享与书展

requirements.en: Please bring a book you would like to discuss.
requirements.zh: 请携带一本你愿意交流的书。

requirements.en: Each participant will have two minutes to introduce their chosen book.
requirements.whyZh: 具体两分钟仅为原创示范，不当真题规定。
requirements.zh: 每位参与者有两分钟介绍自己挑选的书。

switch.invitation: 重点写讨论什么、为什么适合对方
switch.notice: 书目方向、参与对象、需要携带什么
switch.recommendation: 推荐一本书或一场阅读活动，用具体特色支撑理由

Bbridge.en: Community service turns a sense of responsibility into visible action.
Bbridge.zh: 社区服务使责任意识转化为看得见的行动。

benefits.en: Volunteering gives students practical experience in communicating with people from different backgrounds.
benefits.zh: 志愿服务让学生在与不同背景的人交流时获得实践经验。

benefits.en: Small, reliable contributions can make public activities run more smoothly.
benefits.zh: 细致可靠的小贡献能让公共活动开展得更加顺畅。

scenarioCards.core: 服务对象和岗位→具体任务→能力要求→如何参与
scenarioCards.dont: “志愿者需要吃苦耐劳”不是所有岗位都实用；不要设置与任务无关的英语六级限制。

forReader.en: Your experience organizing student events would be useful for the visitor-support team.
forReader.zh: 你组织学生活动的经验能够帮助访客服务团队。

material.en: Volunteers will guide visitors, answer basic questions and help maintain order at the venue.
material.whyZh: 三个职责动词有区别，招聘语境直接得分。
material.zh: 志愿者将引导访客、回答基本问题并协助维持现场秩序。

material.en: Team leaders will provide a short briefing before each shift.
material.whyZh: 原创活动可设；不得当作所有真题的事实。
material.zh: 组长将在每次轮班前进行简短说明。

scenarioCards.name: 志愿服务与公益招募

requirements.en: Applicants should be patient, reliable and able to work well in a team.
requirements.zh: 申请者应当耐心、可靠，并具备团队合作能力。

requirements.en: Interested students should submit their availability and contact details to the organizing committee.
requirements.whyZh: 比随意捏造具体邮箱好。
requirements.zh: 有意报名的学生应向组织委员会提交可参加时段及联系方式。

switch.invitation: 面向认识的同学可强调一起参与，但仍要写明志愿工作的具体职责
switch.notice: 招募岗位＋职责＋报名路径；不能只说做公益意义伟大
switch.recruitment: 筛选标准必须对应岗位，如沟通或时间安排

Bbridge.en: Regular exercise is easier to maintain when it is built into enjoyable social activities.
Bbridge.zh: 当运动融入令人愉快的社交活动时，人们更容易长期坚持。

benefits.en: Team activities provide a chance to build trust while staying physically active.
benefits.zh: 团队活动让人在保持身体活跃的同时建立信任。

benefits.en: The event is intended to make regular exercise more accessible and enjoyable.
benefits.zh: 活动旨在让日常运动更容易参与、更有乐趣。

scenarioCards.core: 赛事内容→参与方式→健康/合作收益→安全或报名安排
scenarioCards.dont: 不能把一场体育活动写成确保提高成绩或预防疾病的医学承诺。

forReader.en: As you enjoy team sports, I thought you might like to join our friendly matches.
forReader.zh: 你喜欢团队运动，所以我想你可能愿意参加我们的友谊赛。

material.en: The sports day will include a relay race, friendly matches and activities for beginners.
material.zh: 运动日将安排接力赛、友谊赛和适合初学者的活动。

material.en: Students can join as competitors or help organize the matches.
material.zh: 学生可以作为参赛者，也可以协助组织比赛。

scenarioCards.name: 校园比赛与健康活动

requirements.en: Participants should wear comfortable sports shoes and follow the safety guidelines.
requirements.zh: 参加者应穿舒适的运动鞋并遵守安全指引。

requirements.en: Please indicate whether you would prefer to compete or volunteer.
requirements.zh: 请说明你更愿意参赛还是担任志愿者。

switch.advice: 循序渐进锻炼与避免受伤的具体方法
switch.invitation: 写比赛项目、参与收益与朋友共同参与
switch.notice: 运动项目、场地、分组和必要安全提示

Bbridge.en: Well-maintained public spaces encourage residents to spend more time outdoors and interact with one another.
Bbridge.zh: 得到良好维护的公共空间能够鼓励居民多参加户外活动并彼此交流。

benefits.en: The activity offers a practical way to improve a shared public space.
benefits.zh: 该活动提供了一个改善公共空间的实际途径。

benefits.en: Taking part can also make environmental responsibility feel more concrete.
benefits.zh: 亲身参与也会让环保责任变得更加具体。

scenarioCards.core: 环保任务→参加动作→可见结果→工具/安全/报名
scenarioCards.dont: 公益活动不是要求在正文中编造具体碳减排数字。

forReader.en: Since you often visit this park, I thought you might enjoy helping improve the space we share.
forReader.zh: 你经常来这个公园，因此我想你或许愿意一起改善我们共享的空间。

material.en: Participants will collect litter along the paths and sort recyclable materials.
material.zh: 参与者将沿步道捡拾垃圾并分类可回收物。

material.en: A short workshop will explain how to reduce waste in everyday life.
material.zh: 简短工作坊将介绍如何在日常生活中减少浪费。

scenarioCards.name: 社区环保与公园公共活动

requirements.en: Gloves and waste bags will be provided, but participants should wear suitable shoes.
requirements.whyZh: 工具供给为原创活动设定。
requirements.zh: 将提供手套和垃圾袋，但参与者应穿适合的鞋子。

requirements.en: Please follow the group leaders and avoid handling hazardous waste.
requirements.whyZh: 有实际安全意义，不制造夸张危机。
requirements.zh: 请听从组长安排，不要处理危险废弃物。

switch.invitation: 告诉朋友做什么、为什么值得加入、工具是否需要自备
switch.notice: 地点集合点、任务、携带物品与安全提醒
switch.recruitment: 招募清理志愿者时说明轮班与职责

Bbridge.en: Meaningful cultural exchange begins with opportunities for people to interact on equal terms.
Bbridge.zh: 有意义的文化交流始于人们能够平等互动的机会。

benefits.en: The program helps visiting students become familiar with the campus and meet local peers.
benefits.zh: 项目帮助来访学生熟悉校园并认识本校同龄人。

benefits.en: Informal conversations can make cultural differences easier to understand.
benefits.zh: 非正式交流能够帮助大家更好地理解文化差异。

scenarioCards.core: 参访路线与互动项目→帮助新朋友融入→时间地点和接待安排
scenarioCards.dont: 不能把“跨文化交流”写成无实质活动的空洞主题演讲。

forReader.en: Your experience studying abroad could help visiting students feel more at ease.
forReader.zh: 你的海外学习经历可以帮助来访学生放松下来。

material.en: The visit will include a tour of the library and a discussion with student volunteers.
material.zh: 参访包括图书馆导览及与学生志愿者的交流。

material.en: Participants will work in small groups to share experiences of campus life.
material.zh: 参与者将分小组分享校园生活经历。

scenarioCards.name: 国际交流与校园参访

requirements.en: Please let us know in advance if you have any accessibility needs.
requirements.zh: 如有无障碍设施方面的需求，请提前告知。

requirements.en: Participants are asked to arrive at the meeting point ten minutes early.
requirements.zh: 请参与者提前十分钟到集合点。

switch.invitation: 为何请对方参加或担任志愿向导
switch.notice: 参访安排和集合信息比泛泛谈友谊重要
switch.reply: 针对交通、语言帮助、如何报名等询问逐项回答

Bbridge.en: Reliable research depends not only on collecting data but also on handling it responsibly.
Bbridge.zh: 可靠的研究不仅取决于数据收集，还取决于负责任地处理数据。

benefits.en: The position provides practical experience in organizing information and working with a research team.
benefits.zh: 这一岗位可以帮助学生积累整理信息和参与研究团队的实践经验。

benefits.en: The findings may help the university understand students’ needs more clearly.
benefits.zh: 调查结果可能帮助学校更清楚地了解学生需求。

scenarioCards.core: 研究对象→助手职责→岗位技能→申请办法
scenarioCards.dont: 招聘研究助手不能把整个主段写成感谢参加问卷的人。

forReader.en: Your experience with campus surveys would be relevant to the role.
forReader.zh: 你的校园调查经验与这个岗位相关。

material.en: The project will examine students’ habits through short questionnaires and interviews.
material.zh: 项目将通过简短问卷和访谈了解学生习惯。

material.en: Assistants will help distribute forms, record responses and check the collected information.
material.zh: 研究助手将协助分发表格、记录答复并检查所收集的信息。

scenarioCards.name: 校园调查与研究助手

requirements.en: Applicants should be careful with details and able to communicate politely with participants.
requirements.zh: 申请者应注重细节，并能礼貌地与调查参与者交流。

requirements.en: All assistants must respect participants’ privacy and follow the project’s instructions.
requirements.whyZh: 调查场景真实必要的责任，值得记。
requirements.zh: 所有助手必须尊重参与者隐私，并遵循项目指引。

switch.advice: 给申请者建议：阅读研究简介、突出沟通和整理能力
switch.notice: 公告说明研究目的、参与者、何时何地填写
switch.recruitment: 明确调查职责、素质要求、报名而非只宣传研究意义

Bbridge.en: Career readiness grows through repeated practice and useful feedback rather than confidence alone.
Bbridge.zh: 职业准备能力来自反复实践和有效反馈，而非单靠自信。

benefits.en: Individual feedback can help applicants present relevant skills more clearly.
benefits.zh: 个性化反馈能帮助求职者更清楚地呈现相关技能。

benefits.en: Practice interviews may reduce uncertainty about the recruitment process.
benefits.zh: 模拟面试可能减轻人们对招聘流程的不确定感。

scenarioCards.core: 明确需求→可操作的准备步骤→帮助与反馈途径
scenarioCards.dont: 不能向对方承诺参加活动就一定拿到工作；政策细节必须核实。

forReader.en: Since you will be applying for internships soon, this workshop could be useful.
forReader.zh: 你很快要申请实习，所以这次工作坊可能对你有帮助。

material.en: The workshop will include CV reviews and practice interviews.
material.zh: 工作坊将安排简历评阅和模拟面试。

material.en: Participants can discuss their applications with senior students and career advisers.
material.zh: 参与者可与高年级学生和职业顾问讨论自己的申请材料。

scenarioCards.name: 求职指导与职业发展

requirements.en: Please bring a draft CV so that the adviser can give specific suggestions.
requirements.zh: 请携带简历初稿，以便顾问提出具体建议。

requirements.en: Students should check current application requirements through official channels.
requirements.whyZh: 法规、签证等易变化信息不可随意断言。
requirements.zh: 学生应通过官方渠道核对最新的申请要求。

switch.advice: 强调明确方向、修改简历、练习面试、确认政策
switch.invitation: 活动提供何种具体指导，如何帮对方解决即将面临的困难
switch.reply: 问求职流程就逐一回答时间、材料和官方信息来源
